subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The enemies __have cross__ the border, treading the soil on which they are to be conquered.
solution:
The correct answer is 'have crossed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Perfect Tense.
 
• The structure for a sentence in Perfect Perfect Tense:
 
 
• Structure: Subject + has/have + V3 + object?
 
• *Example: We have worked as teachers for two years *
 
 
 
• The V3 for the word '**cross**' is '**crossed**'.

 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'The enemies have crossed__ the border, treading the soil on which they are to be conquered.'
